Subject: Acme MAP draft & legal redlines — ownership and turnaround times

Hi Kara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the deep dive on Acme's integration timeline and procurement constraints. As promised, attached is our first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) covering milestones, owners, and suggested target dates. High level recap and next steps below.

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Target integration: Acme Payments -> Redwood inference API for fraud detection (phase 1).
- Target production date: late July; procurement/legal want contract sorted before EOW June 30 to enable engineering kickoff in July.
- Primary dependencies: (1) MSA/DPA finalization, (2) security questionnaire review, (3) test dataset access for eval.

Immediate MAP items (see attached 20250618-Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx)
- Milestone: MSA initial redlines received
  - Owner: Acme Legal (please confirm)
  - Target: 2025-06-19
- Milestone: Redwood provides counter-redlines
  - Owner: Redwood Legal (we propose Rishi as point)
  - Target turnaround: 3 business days after receipt
- Milestone: DPA review
  - Owner: mutually owned (Acme Legal + Redwood Legal)
  - Target: aligned with MSA cadence
- Milestone: SLA negotiation (latency / SLOs)
  - Owner: Product (Redwood) + Acme Eng; legal to review T/Cs
  - Target: complete by 2025-06-25

Questions / asks for Acme Legal
1) Who on Acme Legal will own the MSA redlines? We need a primary contact and expected turnaround time for countering.
2) Any required template clauses or procurement terms (E.g., PO process, additional insurance requirements) we should be aware of now?

Attachments: 20250618-Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP with proposed milestones).

Next steps
- Kara: confirm legal owner + confirm procurement timeline by EOD 6/19
- Marissa: loop in Redwood legal (Rishi) once we have initial redlines; Redwood to aim for 3 business day turnaround on redlines
- Markus: will provide SLA draft language for review by 6/20

Thanks — I'll follow up mid-week with a consolidated MAP once we have your legal contact.

Best,

Marissa —

Thanks for sending. Kara's timeline (initial redlines by COB 6/20) is tight but workable. A couple notes from product/legal ops perspective:

1) Ownership on edits: Redwood Legal will own our counter-redlines, and Rishi is the right contact. We should set an internal SLA for Redwood legal turnaround to keep this moving — propose 2 business days for the initial counter after we receive their redlines, and 3 business days for any subsequent iterations unless they introduce substantial new terms.

2) SLA negotiation: I'll draft suggested SLA language focused on latency SLOs and error handling. Product will own the content; legal will review. We should define what constitutes a "substantial change" that would trigger exec review (e.g., changes that expand liabilities, introduce novel data residency clauses, or require SSO/SCIM obligations).

3) MAP target close date: Given procurement pressure, recommend we set the MAP target close date to 2025-06-30 and track daily until sign. If Acme can deliver redlines on 6/20 and Redwood returns counters by 6/24, we remain on track.

I'll attach a short SLA language stub and will sync with Rishi if any legal-level edits required.

-Markus
